articles.title_en: The Design of Emission Taxes in Markets with New Firm Acquisitions
articles.title_cn: 新企业收购市场中的排放税设计
articles.abstract_en: In the 1990s there was a great deal of interest in the study of the role of endogenous market structure under oligopoly in the characterization of emission taxes. This interest was instrumental in providing policy guidance on the design of emission taxes based on market characteristics. However, the literature has been silent on offering policy recommendations on the design of emission taxes under endogenous market structure in the presence of new firm acquisitions. We build a model where new firms enter the market where some are acquired by an incumbent multi-plant firm, altering the initial market structure. In this framework, we characterize the second-best emission tax and examine the role of the resulting market structure, in particular the role of acquiring more/fewer of the new firms, in the optimal design of emission tax. We argue that, under certain conditions, the acquisition of new firms may lead to higher taxation consistent with the Pigouvian rule or even exceed marginal damages. Our contribution is at the intersection of emission tax design and M &A (new firm acquisition) literature.
articles.abstract_cn: 在1990中，人们对寡头垄断下内生市场结构在排放税特征化中的作用研究产生了浓厚兴趣。这种兴趣有助于基于市场特征提供排放税设计的政策指导。然而，现有文献在存在新企业收购的情况下，对于内生市场结构下排放税设计的政策建议保持沉默。我们构建了一个模型，其中新企业进入市场，部分新企业被在位多工厂企业收购，从而改变了初始市场结构。在此框架下，我们刻画了次优排放税，并考察了由此产生的市场结构的作用，特别是收购更多/更少新企业在排放税最优设计中的作用。我们认为，在特定条件下，新企业的收购可能导致与庇古规则一致的更高税收，甚至超过边际损害。我们的贡献处于排放税设计与并购（新企业收购）文献的交汇点。

articles.title_en: To Abate, or Not to Abate? The Arising of the Win–Win Solution Under Time Consistent Emission Taxation
articles.title_cn: 减排还是不减排？时间一致性排放税下双赢方案的出现
articles.abstract_en: We analyse a model of environmental regulation where two firms can optimally decide to invest in an emission abatement technology and the regulator taxes firms’ emissions in a time-consistent manner. Depending on the values of the parameters measuring the extent of emission abatement that firms may achieve and the degree of product differentiation, we characterize the subgame perfect equilibria, developing all admissible scenarios where either both firms invest in abatement technologies, none of them do, or just one does, and show the conditions under which a win-win solution emerges, validating a strong form of Porter hypothesis. We also extend the main result to the oligopoly game with a generic number of firms.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了一个环境规制模型，其中两家企业可以最优地决定投资于减排技术，而监管者以时间一致性的方式对企业排放征税。根据衡量企业可能实现的减排程度和产品差异化程度的参数值，我们刻画了子博弈完美均衡，发展了所有可允许的情景，即两家企业都投资于减排技术、都不投资、或只有一家投资，并展示了双赢方案出现的条件，验证了波特假说的强形式。我们还将主要结果扩展到具有一般企业数量的寡头博弈中。

articles.title_en: Regulatory Stringency and Emission Leakage Mitigation
articles.title_cn: 监管严格性与排放泄漏缓解
articles.abstract_en: We construct a two-country trade model where emissions are an input in production and generate cross-border pollution. We examine the strategic incentives of an active regulator who sets a binding level of emissions in production. We show that, in the presence of terms of trade and emission leakage strategic motives, tighter regulation can mitigate emission leakage, reduce global pollution, and improve a country’s welfare. This result and the corresponding policy implications depend on the relative magnitude of emissions intensities of goods between sectors and on their relationship in production and consumption.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个两国贸易模型，其中排放是生产中的一种投入，并产生跨境污染。我们考察了一个设定生产排放约束水平的积极监管者的战略激励。我们表明，在存在贸易条件和排放泄漏战略动机的情况下，更严格的监管可以缓解排放泄漏，减少全球污染，并改善一个国家的福利。这一结果及其相应的政策含义取决于部门间商品排放强度的相对大小以及它们在生产和消费中的关系。

articles.title_cn: 可持续性陷阱：耐心与创新
articles.abstract_en: This paper argues that the joint relation between long-term orientation, environmental quality and innovation plays a key role in explaining the economic and the environmental dimension of sustainability. In our model multiple equilibria of economic development and environmental quality can arise due to a trade-off between the demand for innovation that promotes sustainability, and the ephemeral pleasure from polluting manufacturing that impedes it. Additional to traditional policies such as aid and technology transfers, policies that target behavioral changes through environmental protection may provide a double-dividend of economic and environmental sustainability through an environment-patience-innovation channel.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文认为，长期导向、环境质量与创新之间的联合关系在解释可持续性的经济与环境维度方面起着关键作用。在我们的模型中，由于促进可持续性的创新需求与阻碍可持续性的污染制造业的短暂愉悦之间的权衡，经济发展和环境质量的多重均衡可能出现。除了援助和技术转让等传统政策外，通过环境保护针对行为改变的政策可能通过环境-耐心-创新渠道为经济和环境的可持续性提供双重红利。

articles.title_en: Is Green Transition in Europe Fostered by Energy and Environmental Efficiency Feedback Loops? The Role of Eco-Innovation, Renewable Energy and Green Taxation
articles.title_cn: 欧洲绿色转型是否由能源和环境效率反馈回路推动？生态创新、可再生能源和绿色税收的作用
articles.abstract_en: Green transition is in the core of the European policy agenda to achieve the ambitious goal of climate neutrality following the launch of the European Green Deal. The cornerstone of the new growth strategy of Europe is resource efficiency which focuses on shifting to a more sustainable production paradigm by conserving scarce resources and by prioritizing enhanced environmental performance. Scattered efforts to investigate the drivers of resource efficiency measures have shed light on the key drivers, however, those consider resource efficiency measures in isolation neglecting for feedback loops influencing green transition. Therefore, we develop a conceptual framework to study green transition as a system of resource efficiency measures affected by feedback loops, path dependence, green technologies, and green policy tools. We mobilize the analysis by devising a unique balanced panel covering the EU-28 from 2010 through 2019, including policy efforts paving the way for green transition. Econometric results based on a system of fractional probit models, indicate that resource efficiency measures are intertwined via feedback loops, especially in the case of environmental efficiency. Green technologies affect green transition, however, rebound effects emerge in the case of energy efficiency. Past performance affects current levels pushing towards divergence. Evidence suggests that green taxation fosters energy efficiency whereas hinders environmental efficiency. The asymmetric operation of feedback loops and green taxation on energy and environmental efficiency highlights that horizontal policies hinder rather than foster green transition. This study contributes to SDGs 7, 12, 13 and 16.
articles.abstract_cn: 绿色转型是欧洲政策议程的核心，旨在实现欧洲绿色协议启动后气候中和的宏伟目标。欧洲新增长战略的基石是资源效率，其重点是通过节约稀缺资源和优先考虑改善环境绩效，转向更可持续的生产范式。对资源效率措施驱动因素的零散研究已经揭示了关键驱动因素，然而，这些研究孤立地考虑资源效率措施，忽视了影响绿色转型的反馈回路。因此，我们开发了一个概念框架，将绿色转型视为一个由反馈回路、路径依赖、绿色技术和绿色政策工具影响的资源效率措施系统。我们通过构建一个涵盖2010年至2019年欧盟28国的独特平衡面板来推动分析，其中包括为绿色转型铺平道路的政策努力。基于分数概率模型系统的计量经济学结果表明，资源效率措施通过反馈回路相互交织，尤其是在环境效率方面。绿色技术影响绿色转型，但在能源效率方面出现了反弹效应。过去的绩效影响当前水平，推动走向分化。证据表明，绿色税收促进能源效率，但阻碍环境效率。反馈回路和绿色税收对能源和环境效率的不对称运作表明，横向政策阻碍而非促进绿色转型。本研究有助于实现可持续发展目标7、12、13和16。

articles.title_en: Green Energy Pathways Towards Carbon Neutrality
articles.title_cn: 迈向碳中和的绿色能源路径
articles.abstract_en: Trying to reach carbon neutrality is by no means plain sailing in times of energy crisis, price volatility, and war. The European Green Deal (EGD) prioritizes green pathways, but it is not enough when it copes with greenhouse gases (GHGs). The present research utilizes the Malmquist–Luenberger productivity index (MLPI) to estimate advancements in total factor productivity (TFP) in the European Union (EU). The study uses panel data from 1995 to 2019, in addition, there is comparison between two periods: 1995 – 1996 and 2018 – 2019, would provide important information about TFP progress or recession during a turbulent European era. Two MLPI models are applied, one that utilizes only non-renewable energy sources (NRES), while the other adopts renewable energy sources (RES). Encompassing inputs such as: electricity generation, labour force, and gross fixed capital formation (GFCF); desirable output: gross domestic product; and undesirable outputs: carbon dioxide (CO2) and methane (CH4). There is average productivity progress, more specifically the MLPI average productivity for NRES and RES is 2.14% and 7.34% respectively, meaning that the RES adoption leads to greater productivity performance by almost three times. This novel analysis might offer useful and practical information to policymakers through the measuring of TFP in order to effectively attain and accomplish carbon neutrality objectives.
articles.abstract_cn: 在能源危机、价格波动和战争时期，实现碳中和绝非易事。欧洲绿色协议（EGD）优先考虑绿色路径，但在应对温室气体（GHGs）方面仍显不足。本研究利用Malmquist–Luenberger生产率指数（MLPI）来估算欧盟（EU）全要素生产率（TFP）的进步。研究使用了从1995到2019的面板数据，此外，还比较了1995-1996和2018-2019两个时期，这将为欧洲动荡时期TFP的进步或衰退提供重要信息。应用了两种MLPI模型，一种仅使用非可再生能源（NRES），另一种采用可再生能源（RES）。投入包括：发电量、劳动力和固定资本形成总额（GFCF）；期望产出：国内生产总值；非期望产出：二氧化碳（CO2）和甲烷（CH4）。存在平均生产率进步，更具体地说，NRES和RES的MLPI平均生产率分别为2.14%和7.34%，这意味着采用RES导致的生产率绩效几乎是前者的三倍。这项新颖的分析可能通过衡量TFP为政策制定者提供有用且实用的信息，以有效实现和完成碳中和目标。

articles.title_en: Fiscal and Environmental Sustainability: Is Public Debt Environmentally Friendly?
articles.title_cn: 财政与环境可持续性：公共债务是否环境友好？
articles.abstract_en: This article assesses the dilemma that most governments face when seeking to ensure the sustainability of their public finances through economic growth while simultaneously protecting the environment. We propose a growth model in which the government finances abatement-spending through taxation or public debt and which follows a fiscal rule that targets the long-run debt-to-GDP ratio. We show that there is a threshold for the debt ratio below which debt and environmental sustainability are secured. In steady state, the debt ratio exerts a nonlinear effect on environmental quality in the form of an inverted U-shaped curve, and the environmental tax is good for the environment when public debt is not. A fiscal rule authorizing a small but strictly positive debt ratio could help the government to implement adaptation policies for environmental protection while supporting long-run economic growth.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文评估了大多数政府在寻求通过经济增长确保公共财政可持续性，同时保护环境时所面临的困境。我们提出了一个增长模型，其中政府通过税收或公共债务为减排支出融资，并遵循一个以长期债务与GDP比率为目标的财政规则。我们表明，存在一个债务比率阈值，低于该阈值，债务和环境可持续性得以保障。在稳态下，债务比率以倒U型曲线的形式对环境质量产生非线性影响，而当公共债务不利时，环境税对环境有益。一个允许小但严格为正的债务比率的财政规则，可以帮助政府实施环境保护的适应政策，同时支持长期经济增长。

articles.title_en: A Crash Course in Differential Games and Applications
articles.title_cn: 微分博弈及其应用速成课程
articles.abstract_en: The methodology of differential games is a combination of optimal control theory and game theory. It is the natural framework for economic analysis with strategic interaction and dynamical optimization. The theory gained traction by seminal papers in the early seventies, and it gradually found its way into economics. The purpose of this paper is to make theory and applications of differential games easily accessible by explaining the basics and by developing some characteristic applications. The core of the theory focuses on the open-loop and the multiple Markov-perfect Nash equilibria that use the maximum principle and dynamic programming as the techniques to solve the optimal control problems. The applications are the game of international pollution control and the game of managing a lake, which is an example of an ecological system with tipping points. Finally, it is interesting to note that the discovery of time-inconsistency in the open-loop Stackelberg equilibrium had a huge impact on macroeconomics, since policy making under rational expectations is a Stackelberg differential game.
articles.abstract_cn: 微分博弈的方法论是最优控制理论与博弈论的结合。它是具有战略互动和动态优化的经济分析的自然框架。该理论在七十年代初通过开创性论文获得关注，并逐渐进入经济学领域。本文的目的是通过解释基础知识和开发一些典型应用，使微分博弈的理论和应用易于理解。理论的核心集中在开环和多重马尔可夫完美纳什均衡上，这些均衡使用最大值原理和动态规划作为解决最优控制问题的技术。应用包括国际污染控制博弈和湖泊管理博弈，后者是一个具有临界点的生态系统示例。最后，有趣的是，开环斯塔克伯格均衡中时间不一致性的发现对宏观经济学产生了巨大影响，因为理性预期下的政策制定是一个斯塔克伯格微分博弈。

articles.title_en: Escaping Damocles’ Sword: Endogenous Climate Shocks in a Growing Economy
articles.abstract_en: We consider a growing economy which is subject to recurring, random, uninsurable, and potentially large and long-lasting climate shocks leading to destruction of infrastructure, land degradation, collapse of ecosystems or similar loss of productive capacity. The associated damages and the hazard rate are endogenously driven by the stock of greenhouse gases. We highlight the important role of the relative risk aversion and provide analytical solutions for the optimal climate policy, the growth rate and the saving propensity of the economy. We stress the importance of jointly determining these variables, especially if the objective is to formulate meaningful policy prescriptions. If, for example, the growth rate or the saving rate are assumed to be exogenous, and thus independent of the characteristics of climate shocks and economic fundamentals, then future economic developments in the face of climate change and, consequently, the future mitigation efforts will deviate from the optimal paths. In a quantitative assessment we show that with log-utility and under favorable technological and climatic conditions the abatement expenditure represents only 0.5% of output, equivalent to $37 per ton carbon. Under less favorable conditions, coupled with a relative risk aversion which exceeds unity, the abatement propensity increases to 2.9%, equivalent to $212 per ton carbon, and it jumps to a striking 16% in the pessimistic scenario involving severe shocks and low efficiency of abatement technology.

articles.title_en: The Economic Value of Biodiversity Preservation
articles.title_cn: 生物多样性保护的经济价值
articles.abstract_en: We study the decision to preserve diverse species when the value of biodiversity is uncertain, or even affected by ambiguity. Optimal decisions are derived both from the perspective of the producer/investor and the policy regulator (ecosystem planner). We find that while calculated risk creates a scope for biodiversity preservation, the presence of ambiguity aversion reduces it, thus accelerating the extinction of species with lower value. Our results suggest that effective conservation strategies would involve a reduction of ambiguity aversion by creating a stable and transparent policy environment. Furthermore, they may involve a two tier strategy, with one tier addressing output targets and the other conservation targets.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了当生物多样性的价值不确定，甚至受到模糊性影响时，保护多样物种的决策。最优决策分别从生产者/投资者和政策监管者（生态系统规划者）的角度得出。我们发现，虽然计算出的风险为生物多样性保护创造了空间，但模糊厌恶的存在减少了这种空间，从而加速了价值较低的物种的灭绝。我们的结果表明，有效的保护策略将涉及通过创造稳定透明的政策环境来减少模糊厌恶。此外，它们可能涉及两层策略，一层针对产出目标，另一层针对保护目标。

articles.title_en: Consensus Group Decision Making Under Model Uncertainty with a View Towards Environmental Policy Making
articles.title_cn: 模型不确定性下的共识群体决策：面向环境政策制定
articles.abstract_en: In this paper we propose a consensus group decision making scheme under model uncertainty consisting of an iterative two-stage procedure based on the concept of Fréchet barycenter. Each stage consists of two steps: the agents first update their position in the opinion metric space adopting a local barycenter characterized by the agents’ immediate interactions and then a moderator makes a proposal in terms of a global barycenter, checking for consensus at each stage. In cases of large heterogeneous groups, the procedure can be complemented by an auxiliary initial homogenization stage, consisting of a clustering procedure in opinion space, leading to large homogeneous groups for which the aforementioned procedure will be applied. The scheme is illustrated in examples motivated from environmental economics.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们提出了一种在模型不确定性下的共识群体决策方案，该方案基于Fréchet重心概念，由迭代的两阶段程序组成。每个阶段包括两个步骤：首先，代理人采用由其直接互动所刻画的局部重心，在意见度量空间中更新其位置；然后，主持人以全局重心的形式提出建议，并在每个阶段检查共识。在大型异质群体的情况下，该程序可以通过一个辅助的初始同质化阶段加以补充，该阶段包括意见空间中的聚类程序，从而形成大型同质群体，对之应用前述程序。该方案在环境经济学启发的示例中得到了说明。

articles.title_en: The COVID-19 Pandemic and Unsustainable PPE Materials: A Correlation and Causality Analysis
articles.title_cn: COVID-19疫情与不可持续的个人防护装备材料：相关性与因果性分析
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate the economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on European and Chinese unsustainable and non-recyclable plastic markets, specifically those used for the production of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). We explore exogenous economic and commodity price impacts on polypropylene, acrylonitrile and polyvinyl-chloride, via VECM and Granger causality analysis, with the results remaining robust under testing. We find that price shocks from rubber and EUROSTOXX are significantly correlated with PPE materials, to a greater extent than crude oil, unexpectedly relating price declines in PPE materials to factors beyond medical demand. This will aid a policymakers and industry understand the factors that affect the price of unsustainable and non-recyclable PPE materials, respond to the need for pandemic PPE provision and reduce the potential environmental impact of future pandemics.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了COVID-19疫情对欧洲和中国不可持续且不可回收塑料市场（特别是用于生产个人防护装备（PPE）的塑料）的经济影响。我们通过VECM和Granger因果分析，探讨了外部经济和商品价格冲击对聚丙烯、丙烯腈和聚氯乙烯的影响，结果在检验下保持稳健。我们发现，橡胶和EUROSTOXX的价格冲击与PPE材料显著相关，其程度大于原油，这出乎意料地将PPE材料的价格下跌与医疗需求以外的因素联系起来。这将有助于政策制定者和行业理解影响不可持续和不可回收PPE材料价格的因素，应对疫情PPE供应的需求，并减少未来疫情潜在的环境影响。

excluded_items.title_en: Introduction to Essays in Honour of Anastasios Xepapadeas
excluded_items.abstract_en: In 2021, Anastasios Xepapadeas retired as professor of economic theory and policy at the Athens University of Economics and Business, with environmental economics as his main area of interest. From 1987 to 2007, he was affiliated with the University of Crete and since 2017, he is affiliated with the University of Bologna. He has contributed at a high level to all three areas of the academic profession: education, research, and administration. Many of the students he supervised have an academic career. His list of publications is diverse and impressive. He was dean in Crete and in Athens, president of the European Association of Environmental and Resource Economists, co-editor of the Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, and editor of Environment and Development Economics. He was also chair of the board of the Beijer Institute of Ecological Economics at the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences and last but not least, he was elected to the US National Academy of Sciences.
